items.title: Godot XR Community Game Jam VI
items.en_title: Godot XR Community Game Jam VI
items.en_oneliner: The sixth Godot XR community game jam received 28 entries on the theme Adrift, with the article counting down the top five, worth referencing for XR developers.

items.title: Ask HN: Indie Game Recommendations?
items.en_oneliner: A Hacker News user posted asking for recommendations, missing the Flash era experience of casually discovering novel indie games, and wanting recent creative indie works.
